distinguishing_fact: The brass snap hooks are not coated or plated with precious metal, which distinguishes subheading 7419.80.50 from 7419.80.30.
decisive_quote: composed of brass (61% copper, 35% zinc, 4% other material)

rejected.why: Covers articles of copper coated or plated with precious metal; the subject snap hooks are composed of brass without precious metal plating or coating.
Covers copper chain and parts thereof; the snap hook is a fastener/hardware fitting, not chain.
Covers copper springs; the snap hook is an assembly of connection hardware, not a spring.
Covers containers of a kind normally carried on the person, in the pocket or handbag.

reasoning: Under Section XV Note 5, base metal alloys are classified as an alloy of the metal that predominates by weight over each of the other metals. The subject Model 225B snap hooks are composed of 61% copper and 35% zinc, making them copper alloys classified under Chapter 74. Snap hooks feature a spring-loaded latch and functionality beyond generic apparel/luggage hooks of heading 8308, bringing them into the residual heading 7419 for other articles of copper. Following the 2022 HTSUS update, prior subheading 7419.99 was replaced by 7419.80. At the 8-digit level, because the brass snap hooks are not coated or plated with precious metal, they fall into the residual basket subheading 7419.80.50.

citations.quote: Accordingly, the brass rope clamps and brass snap hooks, which are an alloy in which copper predominates over zinc and other unspecified materials, are classified as other articles of copper.

distinguishing_fact: The test strips are diagnostic reagents on a backing for blood glucose monitoring rather than for Zika/mosquito-borne diseases or certified reference materials, and do not contain antigens or antisera.
decisive_quote: designed solely for use by persons with diabetes to monitor their blood glucose levels

rejected.why: Covers diagnostic reagents specifically for Zika and other diseases transmitted by mosquitoes of the genus Aedes; the merchandise is for blood glucose monitoring.
Covers certified reference materials, whereas the subject merchandise consists of diagnostic test strips containing chemical reagents on a backing.

reasoning: The goods are blood glucose test strips made of layers including a chemical reagent on a backing, designed to monitor blood glucose levels. Heading 3822 provides for diagnostic reagents on a backing. Subheading 3822.11 covers reagents for malaria, 3822.12 covers reagents for Zika and other diseases transmitted by mosquitoes of the genus Aedes, 3822.13 covers reagents for blood-grouping, and 3822.90 covers certified reference materials. Reagents on a backing for blood glucose monitoring fall under subheading 3822.19.00 ('Other'). Consistent CBP precedent (e.g., NY N350833, NY N350835) classifies identical blood glucose test strips under 3822.19.0080.

citations.quote: They are designed solely for use by persons with diabetes to monitor their blood glucose levels.
They are designed solely for use by persons with diabetes to monitor their blood glucose levels.

For the purposes of heading 3822, the expression "certified reference materials" means reference materials which are accompanied by a certificate which indicates the values of the certified properties, the methods used to determine these values and the degree of certainty associated with each value and which are suitable for analytical, calibrating or referencing purposes.

distinguishing_fact: The vessel's length of approximately 30 feet (9.144 m) exceeds 7.5 meters but does not exceed 24 meters.

rejected.why: Covers non-inflatable sailboats of a length not exceeding 7.5 m, whereas the subject vessel is approximately 30 feet (9.144 m) long.
Covers non-inflatable sailboats of a length exceeding 24 m, whereas the subject vessel is approximately 30 feet (9.144 m) long.

reasoning: The merchandise is a Hinterhoeller Nonsuch 30 Ultra recreational sailboat with a fiberglass hull and an auxiliary diesel motor. Heading 8903 covers yachts and other vessels for pleasure or sports. Non-inflatable sailboats, with or without auxiliary motor, are sub-divided based on vessel length. The length of approximately 30 feet equals 9.144 meters, which places the vessel into subheading 8903.22 for sailboats of a length exceeding 7.5 m but not exceeding 24 m, corresponding to 8-digit tariff line 8903.22.00.

distinguishing_fact: The goods are artificial turf rather than non-turf tufted carpeting or floor coverings.

rejected.why: Subheading 5703.39 is a residual basket provision for other tufted floor coverings of other man-made textile materials, which yields to the specific tariff line for turf.

reasoning: The merchandise consists of artificial turf of tufted construction featuring a pile made of synthetic polyethylene monofilaments and polypropylene strip inserted into backing. Under Note 1 to Chapter 57, the chapter covers 'floor coverings in which textile materials serve as the exposed surface of the article when in use'. Under heading 5703 ('Carpets and other textile floor coverings (including turf), tufted, whether or not made up'), tufted floor coverings of man-made textile materials other than nylon/polyamides are classified under subheading 5703.31.00 when they are turf.

distinguishing_fact: The yarns are unbleached and not mercerized rather than bleached, dyed, or mercerized.
decisive_quote: composed wholly of unbleached cotton. The yarn is of carded open-end spin construction (not combed) and is not considered mercerized.
reasoning: Heading 5205 covers cotton yarn containing 85 percent or more by weight of cotton, not put up for retail sale. Both yarn samples ('12/1 (Ne)' and '16/1 (Ne)') are 100 percent cotton single yarns of uncombed (carded) fibers and are not put up for retail sale pursuant to Note 4 to Section XI. Their metric counts are 20.1 Nm and 27.03 Nm respectively, placing them in subheading 5205.12 (exceeding 14 nm but not exceeding 43 nm). As the CBP laboratory analysis confirms the yarns are composed wholly of unbleached cotton and are not mercerized, they fall specifically under subheading 5205.12.10.

distinguishing_fact: The bag is designed for holding and organizing hand tools and accessories rather than carrying clothing and personal effects during travel, which excludes it from travel bags under Additional U.S. Note 1 to Chapter 42.
decisive_quote: constructed of 100 percent polyester, which is a man-made textile material.

rejected.why: Covers travel, sports and similar bags of man-made fibers; excluded by Additional U.S. Note 1 to Chapter 42 because it is designed to store hand tools rather than clothing and personal effects during travel.
Covers other containers with outer surface of cotton; the subject article is constructed of 100 percent polyester.
Covers other containers with outer surface of materials other than textile materials; the subject bag has an uncoated outer surface of textile material.

reasoning: Heading 4202 provides eo nomine for tool bags. Under subheading 4202.92, which covers goods with outer surface of sheeting of plastics or of textile materials, the article is evaluated under 'Travel, sports and similar bags' and 'Other'. Additional U.S. Note 1 to Chapter 42 limits 'travel, sports and similar bags' to goods designed for carrying clothing and personal effects during travel; since this article is specifically designed for holding and organizing hand tools, it falls under the 'Other' category. Because it is constructed of 100 percent polyester with an uncoated textile exterior, it is classified under 8-digit subheading 4202.92.91 (10-digit 4202.92.9100).

citations.quote: For the purposes of heading 4202, the expression "travel, sports and similar bags" means goods, other than those falling in subheadings 4202.11 through 4202.39, of a kind designed for carrying clothing and other personal effects during travel, including backpacks and shopping bags of this heading, but does not include binocular cases, camera cases, musical instrument cases, bottle cases and similar containers.
Of man-made fibers (except jewelry boxes of a kind normally sold at retail with their contents) (670)
